player_prompt.intro:
Nan Mastermind hkying sha re.
Nan {code_length} kawoi hku nna re, kawoi kaba hkying 1 kawoi {num_numbers} kawoi rai, {repeats}.
Nan jaw ai majaw, '[2 1 4 5]' hkying re jaw ai sha rai.
Kaba hkying jaw ai hpang, nan hkying jaw ai hpyen pawt hkying re sha rai, hkying pawt hkying re hku nna re.
Hkying pawt hkying re jaw ai hku nna, nan jaw ai hpyen pawt hkying re sha rai, hkying pawt hkying re hku nna re.
Nan {max_turns} kawoi jaw ai sha re.
